pr_files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+# Lifecycle entry point.  Every primitive MUST declare this contract — `rbnx boot`
+# calls Driver(CMD_INIT, config_json) against it and waits for ok=true.
+[contract]
+id      = "robonix/primitive/hand/driver"
+version = "1"
+kind    = "primitive"
+idl     = "lifecycle/srv/Driver.srv"
+
+[mode]
+type = "rpc"

@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+# Query hand metadata — joint count, names, and model.  LLM-facing MCP tool.
+# Consumer calls this first to discover the expected array length for move_joint,
+# enabling model-agnostic adaptation across different dexterous hands.
+[contract]
+id      = "robonix/primitive/hand/info"
+version = "1"
+kind    = "primitive"
+idl     = "hand/srv/GetHandInfo.srv"
+
+[mode]
+type = "rpc"

@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+# Set all joint positions (0=open, 1=closed).  LLM-facing MCP tool.
+# Request includes joint_names alongside positions so the driver can validate
+# joint order.  Call info first to discover expected array length and names.
+[contract]
+id      = "robonix/primitive/hand/move_joint"
+version = "1"
+kind    = "primitive"
+idl     = "hand/srv/MoveJoint.srv"
+
+[mode]
+type = "rpc"

@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+# Set speed limit per joint (0-1).  NOT exposed as MCP — LLM should not
+# tune motor parameters directly; skill/service set these in task context.
+[contract]
+id      = "robonix/primitive/hand/set_speed_limits"
+version = "1"
+kind    = "primitive"
+idl     = "hand/srv/SetSpeedLimits.srv"
+
+[mode]
+type = "rpc"

@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+# Set torque limit per joint (0-1).  NOT exposed as MCP — same reasoning as
+# set_speed_limits: motor parameters belong in skill/service task context.
+[contract]
+id      = "robonix/primitive/hand/set_torque_limits"
+version = "1"
+kind    = "primitive"
+idl     = "hand/srv/SetTorqueLimits.srv"
+
+[mode]
+type = "rpc"

@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+# Continuous ROS 2 topic stream of current joint positions.
+# Publishes JointState messages (float64[] values) at driver-native rate.
+# Array order matches info.joint_names — consumer must query info first
+# to map indices to joint names.
+[contract]
+id      = "robonix/primitive/hand/state_joint"
+version = "1"
+kind    = "primitive"
+idl     = "hand/msg/JointState.msg"
+
+[mode]
+type = "topic_out"

@@ -0,0 +1,11 @@
+# Continuous ROS 2 topic stream of current joint speeds.
+# Reuses JointState message — semantics: values → speed.
+# Array order matches info.joint_names.
+[contract]
+id      = "robonix/primitive/hand/state_speed"
+version = "1"
+kind    = "primitive"
+idl     = "hand/msg/JointState.msg"
+
+[mode]
+type = "topic_out"
